message.content: It depends on what you’re looking for—genre, critical acclaim, or audience reception—but many critics and audiences agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was still dominating conversations into 2020, especially after its historic Oscar wins. If you’re looking for something more recent from 2020 itself, **“Tenet”** (2020) was a high‑profile release that sparked intense discussion, while indie gems like **“Nomadland”** (though released in late 2020) received widespread praise for its storytelling and performances. Ultimately, the “best” film will vary with your taste, but those titles were among the most talked‑about and critically lauded releases around that time.
